title: Fibonacci EA v5.0 Bidirectional Trading Enablement Test
research_question: Does enabling bidirectional execution (InpDirection = 2, Both BUY & SELL) relative to baseline EXP-0006 generate non-zero short trades and increase total net profit while remaining within the 8.0% prop firm drawdown limit on GBPUSD M15?
hypothesis: Enabling both BUY and SELL trade directions will allow the EA to capture bearish Fibonacci swing retracements during market downtrends, resulting in non-zero short trades (short_trades > 0) and increasing total net profit above the baseline $302.08, while maximum equity drawdown remains <= 8.0%.

facts: EXP-0006 recorded exactly 230 long trades and 0 short trades under factory default InpDirection=0.
EXP-0006 recorded total net profit of $302.08, profit factor 1.08, and max equity drawdown of 7.46% on GBPUSD M15 across 2020-2024.
inferences: The factory baseline EA is completely blind to bearish trends and bearish Fibonacci swing retracements.
Market regimes on GBPUSD M15 alternate between bullish and bearish swings, and capturing both directions will double trade opportunity capture and diversify trend exposure.
evidence: EXP-0006 long_trades=230, short_trades=0, total_net_profit=302.08, profit_factor=1.08, equity_drawdown_maximal_percent=7.46

independent_variables.name: InpDirection
independent_variables.rationale: Enable bidirectional execution (0=BUY only -> 2=Both BUY and SELL) to capture bearish swing retracements.

assumptions: EA swing detection, Fibonacci level calculation, and sell order execution logic function symmetrically for short trades as they do for long trades.
The 50 EMA trend filter and session filters operate correctly on bearish market legs.
expected_observations: Short trades count will be > 0 (at least 50 short trades).
Total trades will increase from 230 to at least 300.
falsification_conditions: Short trades remain exactly 0 after setting InpDirection=2.
Total net profit drops below baseline $302.08.
Max equity drawdown exceeds 8.0%, violating the prop firm guard.
